verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets researchers scope a run by selecting which sources to use, choose a conversational style/persona (e.g. 'PhD student') for chat responses, and pick report/format types (FAQ, briefing, deep-dive audio) before generation — all forms of pre-run steering of scope and depth. However there is no evidence of adjusting effort or depth once a generation (e.g. audio/video overview, report) is already executing, nor any explicit 'effort' control. Missing for 10: mid-execution steering/interruption of an in-progress run, an explicit effort/depth dial, and independent confirmation that these controls meaningfully change research depth.
